answer: The economy spends reputation the way a market spends money: sparingly and against verified performance, so Sybil inflation is filtered out before it can compound into a decisive advantage. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds. Consider a wharf as the anchor of the cost.
